title: Monolithic Test-Only Configuration Incongruence
damaged_code:
```yaml
# test_configuration.yaml
# Completely ignores the firewall and cluster settings of the target deployment
database_host: "localhost"
instances: 1
```
pattern: Maintaining isolation profiles or integration test configurations that omit fundamental topological realities (such as cluster layouts, firewalls, or load-balancers) of production.
why_bad: Masks catastrophic configuration bugs. Code that functions perfectly under simple single-node local testing profiles crashes instantly when hitting multi-node production firewalls or clustering rules.
detection: Integration test setups that execute against custom, stripped-down configurations instead of staging setups matching production topologies.
counterexample: Verifying deployments in environment profiles containing matched network policies and load balancers.
fix: Ensure test configurations mirror production topology as closely as possible; include simulated network layers and firewall gates within test runners.
source: [Pragmatic Programmers] Michael T. Nygard - *Release It!_ Design and Deploy Production-Ready Software* (2007, Pragmatic Bookshelf).pdf, Section 11.2 / Section 14.2.
